notes.title: 📢 I Would Love Your Feedback! 🚀
notes.content:
Hey awesome Stack World players!

First off, a HUGE thank you for playing my game! Your support means the world to me. 💖

I am always looking to improve and bring you the best experience possible. If you’re enjoying the game, I would love to hear your thoughts! Leaving a review on Steam helps the game a lot—it allows me to keep improving and lets others know what to expect.

🔹 How to Leave a Review?
👉 Just head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935300/Stack_World/]Stack World Store Page [/url] and click the “Write a Review” button. It only takes a minute!

Every review—big or small—makes a huge difference and helps shape the future of Stack World.

Thank you for being part of this journey with me! 🎮💙

– dev4all dev
